registryEntry.label: Entra Password Protection - Banned Password Check On (Password Rule Settings)
registryEntry.get_command: @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/groupSettings').value | Where-Object { $_.templateId -eq '5cf42378-d67d-4f36-ba46-e8b86229381d' })[0] | ForEach-Object { $v = @{}; foreach ($x in @($_.values)) { $v[[string]$x.name] = [string]$x.value }; [pscustomobject]@{ id = $_.id; displayName = $_.displayName; enableBannedPasswordCheck = $v['EnableBannedPasswordCheck']; hasBannedPasswordList = (@(([string]$v['BannedPasswordList']) -split [char]9 | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0) } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
registryEntry.set_command: $t = '5cf42378-d67d-4f36-ba46-e8b86229381d'; $list = @('password','welcome','changeme','letmein','qwerty','cmmc') -join [char]9; $s = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/groupSettings').value | Where-Object { $_.templateId -eq $t })[0]; $vals = [ordered]@{}; if ($s) { foreach ($x in @($s.values)) { $vals[[string]$x.name] = [string]$x.value } }; $vals['EnableBannedPasswordCheck'] = 'True'; if (-not $vals['BannedPasswordList']) { $vals['BannedPasswordList'] = $list }; $body = @{ values = @($vals.Keys | ForEach-Object { @{ name = $_; value = $vals[$_] } }) }; if ($s) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method PATCH -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/groupSettings/$($s.id)" -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -ContentType 'application/json' } else { $body.templateId = $t; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method 'POST' -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/groupSettings' -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -ContentType 'application/json' }
